title: F7 documentation and integration verification

conformance.reason: Task 20.3 is documentation reconciliation and integration verification of behaviour already implemented and reviewed in 20.1/20.2. It adds no new Jellyfin 12 platform assumption, provider contract, or first-time ADR-against-host implementability question; it records the resolution of F7, adds ADR amendment notes without rewriting accepted text, corrects architecture wording, and adds one deterministic reconciler-resume regression test over the existing recovery gate.

rework.reason: Phase-reviewer finding PR-20-01 (open, MEDIUM): Goal F7 requires ADR-009 and ADR-002/ADR-003 amendment notes; task 20.3 attempt 1 recorded ADR-009 and ADR-003 but no ADR-002 note, and the plan-of-record deliverable list had dropped ADR-002. The worker added the addition-only ADR-002 amendment note and index row and reconciled the PLANS.md Phase 20 deliverable to name ADR-002; the implementation-reviewer re-review (attempt 2) verified PR-20-01 closed. No tests changed in this correction, so no test-quality re-audit was required.

notes: Runtime figures are the authoritative OpenCode server values for each child session (read directly from the running server because the collect-session-usage.sh CLI cannot talk to this server instance). implementation-reviewer and test-quality-reviewer reported cost_usd 0 (the provider's runtime value), recorded as-is. Attempt 1 had no open implementation-reviewer findings; the test-quality-reviewer returned PASS_WITH_FINDINGS with INFORMATIONAL findings only. Task 20.3 then ran one correction round (worker attempt 2 + implementation-reviewer attempt 2) to close phase-reviewer finding PR-20-01 (missing ADR-002 amendment note): the worker added the addition-only ADR-002 note and its decisions-index row and reconciled the PLANS.md Phase 20 deliverable, and the re-review approved. TQR-20.2-01 was closed by the new ArtworkReconcilerTests.RestorationWithAnAbsentBaselineIsResumedAsARemoval case. This task also corrected the architecture-09 absent-baseline removal wording flagged by the task 20.1 test-quality audit. No test-quality re-audit was required for the documentation-only correction.
